grammar_focus: 复习 KS21/45/69 被动语态各时态综合(收官包·换道具照搬结构):一般现在/一般过去被动(is admired / was given)、现在完成被动(has been kept)、将来被动(will be moved)、现在进行被动(is being built)、情态被动(can be enjoyed / should be treasured),以及被动句中用 by 引出动作的发出者
scene: 很久以前,一位著名的艺术家把一座漂亮的老钟赠给了我们镇。这座钟完全是手工制作的,人人见了都赞叹不已。多年来,它一直摆在市政厅的正门口。每天早上,看管人都会细心地给它上发条。最近,城里来的一位专家为它做了修复。“这座钟被一代又一代人珍爱着,”市长说。不久,它就会被搬到新图书馆,让更多人能欣赏到它。一个特制的展柜正在打造中,用来保护它。它将被陈列在孩子们能了解它历史的地方。这样一份礼物理应被珍藏——而它也一定会被珍藏下去。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS21/45/69 被动语态各时态
grammar_card.intro: 被动语态由 be + 过去分词构成,表示“被……”。本课把各时态的被动放在一起复习:①一般现在/一般过去被动——is admired / was given;②现在完成被动——has been kept(一直被……);③将来被动——will be moved;④现在进行被动——is being built(正在被……);⑤情态被动——can be enjoyed / should be treasured。被动句里若要说“由谁做的”,用 by 引出(was repaired by an expert)。

rows: 一般现在 / 一般过去
It is admired by everyone. / It was given long ago.
It has been kept in the town hall for years.
Soon it will be moved to the new library.
A special case is being built to protect it.
It should be treasured. / It was repaired by an expert.

specialRules.rule: 美语“电梯”说 elevator(英式 lift);“一楼”说 first floor(英式 ground floor)。本课已按美语写。
被动 = be 的相应时态 + 过去分词;现在进行被动是 is/are being + 过去分词;情态被动是 can/should + be + 过去分词;“由谁做”用 by 引出。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How was the old clock made?

passage: A beautiful old clock was given to our town by a famous artist long ago. It was made entirely by hand and is admired by everyone who sees it. For years it has been kept in the town hall's main entrance. Every morning it is wound carefully by the caretaker. Recently it was repaired by an expert from the city. "This clock has been loved for generations," the mayor said. Soon it will be moved to the new library so more people can enjoy it. A special case is being built to protect it. It will be displayed where children can learn its history. Such a gift should be treasured, and it always will be.

stage5.stem: "Right now, the old clock ___ by an expert."(现在进行被动:正在被检查)

stage5.stem: "The hall ___ for the ceremony at the moment."(现在进行被动:正在被布置)

stage5.stem: "Such a gift ___."(情态被动:理应被珍藏)

stage5.stem: "The clock was repaired ___ an expert from the city."(被动句里引出“由谁做”)

stage5.stem: "The clock was a ___ gift from a kind artist."(慷慨的用哪个词)
